caseNameFull: Jackson v. Perry, Governor of Texas American GI Forum of Texas v. Perry, Governor of Texas Lee v. Perry, Governor of Texas Travis County, Texas v. Perry, Governor of Texas and Henderson v. Perry, Governor of Texas

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. E. D. Tex. Motion of appellant in No. 03-9644 for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Judgment vacated, and cases remanded for further consideration in light of Vieth v. Jubelirer, 541 U. S. 267 (2004).
